svg.title: Architectural drawing
svg.desc: Cutaway isometric of a yurt: a circular expanding-lattice wall held by a tension band, roof poles leaning in from its top to a central crown ring, a timber door frame, and a felt cover, shown here on the far half only so the frame can be seen. Source: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.
svg.text: SOURCE: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric
construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.
